attacks.claim: Boundary case bc1 (delivery 2025-12-10, petition 2026-06-08): Codex and the case writer give inTime; keep both readings in an open point and make the item warn; do not settle it either way.
attacks.verifierQuote: «تحسب كل الآجال المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون كاملة، ولا يحسب يوم التبليغ أو التبليغ الرسمي ويوم انقضاء الأجل.» (cpca 405 ¶1); «في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح» (cpca 504 ¶1)
attacks.change: The record held one counting only. 405 ¶1 excludes the day of «التبليغ أو التبليغ الرسمي», and 504 ¶1 starts from «تسليم» (delivery), so the text also allows the reading that the delivery day counts and the period ends on the matching day (2026-06-10 here) rather than the day after (2026-06-11). Added to d1, d2 and d3 an otherCountings entry {excludeFirstDay, extendToWorkingDay true, basis b21, b22, b54, b24}; added open point o15 (grade C) with both readings and the protective reading (file before the earlier last day; warn until the later last day and its band; no block before); the messages of d1, d2 and d3 now name both readings and their sources; k14 and k45 refer to o15. The petition is in time under both readings and inside the 15-day band: d1 warns, does not block (example vex9).

attacks.claim: The owner's rule of 15 November 2026: where readings differ on a forfeiture's last day, block only once the latest defensible last day and its band have passed, warn before, keep the held counting in `counting`, list every other defensible counting in `otherCountings`, and make the message name each reading and its source, including whether CPCA 405 applies to the deadline of Law 90-04 and of CPCA 504.
attacks.verifierQuote: «تحسب كل الآجال المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون كاملة، ولا يحسب يوم التبليغ أو التبليغ الرسمي ويوم انقضاء الأجل.» (cpca 405 ¶1); «إذا كان اليوم الأخير من الأجل ليس يوم عمل كليا أو جزئيا، يمدد الأجل إلى أول يوم عمل موالي.» (cpca 405 ¶4); «يجب رفع الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح، وذلك تحت طائلة سقوط الحق في رفع الدعوى.» (cpca 504 ¶1); «في حالة عدم المصالحة، يرفع الطرف الذي له مصلحة دعوى أمام المحكمة الفاصلة في المسائل الاجتماعية.» (labour-disputes 36 ¶1)
attacks.change: Applied to all three forfeitures (d1, d2, d3), which share the period of cpca 504 ¶1. Held counting kept: excludeFirstAndLastDay with extension (405 ¶1, ¶2, ¶3, ¶4), the latest last day. Added otherCountings [{excludeFirstDay, extendToWorkingDay true, basis b21, b22, b54, b24}]: the delivery day counts because 405 ¶1 excludes only the day of notification or service, so the period ends one day earlier. Not added: a counting without extension, since 405 ¶1 and ¶4 govern «كل الآجال المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون» and 504 is in that Code, so no defensible reading takes the extension away (the periods module d5/d9 holds the same). Law 90-04 has no deadline in this record: its article 36 ¶1 sends the claim to the court without setting a period, so 405's reach over a Law 90-04 period does not arise; the messages say so and d1, d2 cite b19. The month-end question (o12) cannot be written as a counting; its readings differ by at most three days, inside the 15-day band, so the block never falls before the latest reading's last day. Messages of d1, d2 and d3 now name each reading with its source and (d1) say the export is blocked only after the later last day and its band; new open point o15. Examples vex18 (delivery 2025-12-10, petition 2026-06-26: warn) and vex19 (petition 2026-06-27: block) pass.
